run-model-witness.py.text:
from pathlib import Path
import os,json,subprocess,datetime
r=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;out=r/'windows-model-witness-run';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
prior=json.loads((r.parent/'llmx-q8-floor-current-20260920/results.json').read_text());assert prior['status']=='pass'
report={'status':'running','scope':'Activation witness only, not HF correctness or performance. Model hashes verified by preceding timing preparation; same paths and sizes; no intervening model writes.','commands':[]}
def save():(out/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
save()
try:
 for name in ['0.6b','8b']:
  model=Path(prior['models'][name]['path']);assert model.stat().st_size==prior['models'][name]['bytes']
  active=subprocess.check_output(['powershell','-NoProfile','-Command',"Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -eq 'llmx' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Id"],text=True)
  assert not active.strip(),'user inference active'
  command=[str(r/'validation/bin/model-witness.exe'),str(model),str(r/'validation/tokens-247.txt')]
  row={'name':name,'command':command,'started':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'model_sha256':prior['models'][name]['sha256'],'model_mtime_ns':model.stat().st_mtime_ns}
  report['commands'].append(row);save();print('START',name,flush=True)
  p=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,timeout=300)
  (out/(name+'.stdout')).write_bytes(p.stdout);(out/(name+'.stderr')).write_bytes(p.stderr)
  row.update(returncode=p.returncode,completed=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat());save()
  print(name,p.returncode,p.stdout.decode(errors='replace'),p.stderr.decode(errors='replace'),flush=True)
  p.check_returncode()
 report['status']='pass';save()
except BaseException as e:report.update(status='failed',error=repr(e));save();raise
